200m/s. Thefocus position parameters intheexperiments wereshownin_ Table1.The positive number indicates that the geometric focus is above the workpiece,0indicates that the geometric focus is on the surface of the workpiece,the negative number indicates that the geometricfocus is locatedinside the workpiece. The specific value indicates the distance between the geometric focus and thesurface of the sample. The optimal machining focus position under each laser power was judged by the difference among the processing time,the diameter of the entrance hole and the set diameterof rotating cutting. The relationship between the diameter of the entrance hole and the focus position at 1W,1.5Wand 2W power is shown in Figure 4. In the experiment,the diameter of thehole entrancefirstlydecreasedand thenincreased with thefocus position from 0.5mm to 4mm. When the defocusing amount reached -1mm,the time consumptionfor machiningthe through hole had little difference. The results above indicate that when the micro-hole is machined by low repetition frequency femtosecond laser,a certain amount of defocusing is needed to optimize the accuracy and efficiency of machining. From the analysis of the Figure,it canbe concludedthat the optimal machiningfocus position at 1.5Wand 2Wpower is —2mm,-3mmand -3.5mm,respectively.

Figure 5 shows that the microstructure of machined micro-hole wall was also closely related to the different focus position when the power of femtosecond laser was 1.5W.With theincrease of defocus, the quality of hole wall increased and the taper became smaller.

The experimental results show that the machiningeffectof the sample whenfocus position located on the surface was not different from that of the positive defocus,which indicated that the geometricfocus was not the maximum energy position after laser focusing. Due to the Kerr self-focusing phenomenon of femtosecond laser propagating in air and the defocusing effectof the plasma phenomena,the maximum energy position of femtosecond laser was not the geometric focus,but shifted to the incidence side, which means negative defocusing is needed in the process of machining. With the increase offemtosecond laser power,the influence of Kerr self-focusing_and plasma phenomena on the laser energy distribution along the laser propagation direction become greater,so the maximum energy point is far away from the position of geometric focus. Therefore,the optimal defocusing amount under different power is different.The larger the power is,the more defocusing it needs. The qualityof the micro-holes machined under the optimal defocusing amount was improved, but the diameter of outlet hole was relatively small. With theincrease of_ defocusing amount,the maximum energy position is closer to the exit,and the absorbed of laser energy at theexit side increases. The removal of materials increased and exports expanded. As shownin Figure 6,however,the morphologyofoutlet drilled under1.5Wpower withoptimal defocusing is rectangular. The analysis of this phenomenon was shown in the third section. Therefore, it is necessary to further improve its processing technology.
